title: BR-MANGUE Studio
description:
BR-MANGUE Studio is a Python desktop application for spatial cellular modelling of mangrove response to sea-level change. It supports aligned categorical land-cover and elevation rasters, standard or user-defined classes with behavior profiles, continuous and persistent-block processing, fixed sediment accretion, maturation delays, and constant or calendar-based sea-level forcing. Annual maps, trajectory tables, source samples, and run metadata support reproducible experiments.

Version 1.4.0 introduces cumulative sea-level trajectories imported from CSV, linear interpolation between calendar years, rebasing to the initial raster year, curve previews, bilingual format guidance, and export of the actual annual forcing. English and Brazilian Portuguese are available in both desktop builds.

The GitHub archive preserves the source code. Windows and Linux executables and their checksums are available on the corresponding GitHub release.

A small third-party CC BY 4.0 data fixture is included for numerical-boundary regression testing. Dataset attribution and extraction details are in tests/fixtures/README.md. The software code is MIT licensed.
notes: This study was financed in part by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior - Brasil (CAPES) - Finance Code 001.
